propositions: Backfill close_class for closed bugs lacking it using only structural signals: revert of STATUS/COMMITS events infers regression, plan-review BLOCK infers plan_defect, gate_error_v1 infers env_integration, otherwise undetermined.
Only backfill bugs where state["close_class"] is absent; skip bugs with authoritative close_class values to preserve ground truth.
Backfilled records must be written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson as NDJSON with source="backfill_classified" and confidence="classified" to segregate from authoritative values.
Script must be idempotent by ticket_id: skip any bug already present in the artifact and any bug with existing state["close_class"], supporting --dry-run mode.

Revert signal requires target_event_type of STATUS or COMMITS (substantive), not COMMENT/LINK; plan-review BLOCK is detected via all_review_results; gate_error_v1 requires raw event-file scan of REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT streams.

All four classification types (regression, plan_defect, env_integration, undetermined) must be covered by unit tests asserting exact close_class values and verifying source/confidence fields and authoritative-value protection.
